It would be nice to be able to share a message that would appear in the discussion for a link, same as a discussion post.

This brings a problem with voting: if a link is good but a note is bad (or vice versa), how would it be voted on? I don't want to upvote a pretty good article when it is accommodated by a stupid comment because it'll increase in exposure. This problem doesn't exist right now because, to add a 'note', you have to make a separate comment which can be voted on separately.

Another problem would be whether or not the note can be edited.

I think the current process is pretty good as it is. If someone wants to add a note, they need to make a comment so it can stand on its own and voted upon separately. It's also beneficial to the OP because they will gain CCP if their 'note' gains positive traction. When it comes down to it, there is little difference.
